title: Create Powah
description: A Create-focused modpack with automation, exploration, and cozy building.
body: A fun and immersive Minecraft modpack centered around Create and its addons, combining automation, exploration, and decoration. Build complex machines, explore enhanced worlds with Biomes O' Plenty, and enjoy cozy farming with Farmer's Delight. Packed with quality-of-life improvements, new structures, and decorative options, this modpack is perfect for both creative builders and survival players looking for a balanced and engaging experience.
